correctness.rationale: The nested-set graph-associahedron gives a D7-equivariant boundary sphere S(V) of dimension 5, and its barycentric dual is the C7 tubing complex. The quotient can be modeled by proper Boolean-subset chains on 7 labels; chain orbits have no inversions because cardinalities are preserved. Independently reconstructed all 14 dihedral actions and all chains: original f-vector (126,1806,8400,16800,15120,5040), quotient f-vector (16,147,612,1200,1080,360), exact signed d²=0. Replayed all 1,705 pivots of assigned integral certificate, each a unit and legal in its active matrix; pivot counts (15,132,480,719,359), remaining groups (1,0,0,1,2,1), matrices d4=(7,7), d5=(-2,2), final d²=0. Smith group calculations yield H3=Z/7 and H4=Z/2 and no other reduced H. S5 covering sphere is simply connected, each reflection fixes an S2 and reflections generate D7; Armstrong orbit π1 theorem gives π1=1. Rational acyclicity or modular ranks alone would not prove both torsion groups; integral pivots do.
residual_risks: No claim about larger cycles, other subgroups, integral homotopy decomposition into Moore wedges, or free D7 action.
